productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: With songs for all four seasons, garden, beach and snow days this album is designed to be enjoyed throughout the year. Take a walk through Spring, a swim through Summer, then drift into Autumn and slide into Winter with these seasons and weather inspired songs for kids. Tracks included: Apple Tree I Love The Rain Every Day Is A Dance Walking Through The Seasons Kids In Autumn (Acapella) The Acorns Roll Dear Umbrella Winter Snow Clouds Pom Poms Hello Neighbourhood Spring Song Save The Daisies (Garden Song) Listen to the Leaves - Whakarongo ki ngā Rau Summertime and Sunshine Camping Holiday Happy Place Lucky Rainbow The Weather Report Heart Beats Treehouse The Wind Kind Words The Skybirds Grandfather Tree
productOnPage.descriptionHtml: Take a walk through Spring, a swim through Summer, then drift into Autumn and slide into Winter with these seasons and weather inspired songs for kids.
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: With songs for all four seasons, garden, beach and snow days this album is designed to be enjoyed throughout the year._**

Take a walk through Spring, a swim through Summer, then drift into Autumn and slide into Winter with these seasons and weather inspired songs for kids.

Tracks included:

*   Apple Tree
*   I Love The Rain
*   Every Day Is A Dance
*   Walking Through The Seasons
*   Kids In Autumn (Acapella)
*   The Acorns Roll
*   Dear Umbrella
*   Winter Snow
*   Clouds
*   Pom Poms
*   Hello Neighbourhood
*   Spring Song
*   Save The Daisies (Garden Song)
*   Listen to the Leaves - Whakarongo ki ngā Rau
*   Summertime and Sunshine
*   Camping Holiday
*   Happy Place
*   Lucky Rainbow
*   The Weather Report
*   Heart Beats
*   Treehouse
*   The Wind
*   Kind Words
*   The Skybirds
*   Grandfather Tree

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)
